title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Customer Tenure, Misdeclaration Block and Resubmission Waiting Periods
content:
Three periods measured in calendar days describe the applicant side of Dangerous Goods Acceptance: how old the customer's profile with the line has to be, how long a misdeclaration penalty keeps the customer's new applications for the category out, and how long a booking must wait after a rejection before a fresh application for it is taken.

| Category | Minimum age of the customer profile (days) | Block after a misdeclaration penalty (days) | Wait after a rejection, same booking (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 0 | 180 | 0 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 0 | 180 | 0 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 0 | 365 | 1 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 90 | 365 | 2 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 90 | 365 | 2 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 365 | 730 | 7 |

## Reading notes

- Three categories set no minimum profile age (a figure of 0); only ranks 4 to 6 look at how long the customer has been with the line.
- The block figure that governs a new application is the one of the category that application is made under.
